subject: planner: integrate hashEqual interface into LogicalPlan and expression.Expression. (#55652)
summary: Adds a new Hash64/Equals (HashEquals) interface and FNV-1a-style hasher utilities under `pkg/planner/cascades/base`, wires `base.LogicalPlan` to embed it, and provides initial implementations in logical plan base/projection. No remaining Blocker/High planner correctness/semantics issues found in this commit relative to its first parent.
